working_title: How I Quote a Job in Under a Minute

title_options: How I Quote a Job in Under a Minute
The 60-Second Quote That Wins the Job
packaging.thumbnail_concept: Owner holding a phone with a stopwatch overlay reading 0:58, brand colours behind.
packaging.angle: The quote is the sale, not the paperwork after it.

beats.spoken: I quote most jobs in under a minute, on the spot.
beats.b_roll: Close-up of the owner tapping out a quote on a phone at a job site.

beats.spoken: Here is the exact way I do it, so you can win the job before you leave the driveway.
beats.on_screen: Win the job before you leave
beats.b_roll: Owner walking back to the van, giving a thumbs up.

beats.spoken: First, I price the three things that matter most and I keep a short list of standard rates on my phone so the numbers are ready before I even arrive.
beats.on_screen: Standard rates, ready on your phone
beats.b_roll: Screen recording of a simple rate list.

beats.spoken: Now here is the part most people miss, and it is the reason the fast quote actually lands.
I say the price out loud, confidently, and then I stay quiet and let the customer respond, because the pause does the selling for me.
beats.b_roll: Two-shot of the owner and a customer nodding.

beats.spoken: One customer told me the fast, clear quote was the reason they picked us over two other plumbers who never called back.
beats.b_roll: Text overlay of a real review, used only where one exists.

beats.spoken: Then I send the written version the same day, so the number they already agreed to is simply confirmed, not renegotiated.
beats.b_roll: Phone showing a quote email being sent.

beats.spoken: If you want a quote like that for your own job, book a free quote call and I will walk you through it.
beats.b_roll: End card with the booking link and brand logo.
